parts.title: Word List
parts.content:
Detailed Meanings

1
accent[æksent]n.
An accent is a certain way of speaking that shows where a person is from. (giọng, chất giọng)
➔ The new teacher's accent was clearly a German one.
2
barber[barbər]n.
A barber is a person whose job is to cut hair. (thợ cắt tóc)
➔ My hair is getting much too long. I'd better go to the barber's shop.
3
basement[beismənt]n.
A basement of a house or building is a room that is built underground. (tầng hầm)
➔ They turned their basement into a game room.
4
blank[blænk]adj.
When something is blank, it does not have anything on it. (trống, để trắng)
➔ She got a blank paper to draw on.
5
blink[bliŋk]v.
To blink means to shut the eyes and quickly open them again. (chớp mắt)
➔ I blinked many times so that my eyes could adjust to the bright light.
6
choir[kwaiər]n.
A choir is a group of people who sing together. (dàn hợp xướng)
➔ He had choir practice every day after school.
7
comic[kamik]adj.
When something is comic, it is funny. (hài hước)
➔ The comic actor was famous for his jokes.
8
complicate[kamplikeit]v.
To complicate something means to make it harder than necessary. (làm phức tạp)
➔ The bad weather complicated finishing the job quickly.
9
decline[diklain]v.
To decline an offer or invitation means to say no to it. (từ chối)
➔ She declined his offer to pay for her dinner.
10
errand[erənd]n.
An errand is a trip taken to do a specific activity. (việc vặt)
➔ He couldn't go to practice because he had several errands to do.
11
glove[glʌv]n.
A glove is a piece of clothing that covers your fingers and hand. (găng tay)
➔ When it gets cold, I always put on a pair of gloves.
12
hermit[hərmit]n.
A hermit is one who lives alone and does not spend time with others. (người ẩn dật)
➔ The hermit lived a simple life in a small cave in the forest.
13
justly[ʤʌstli]adv.
If something is done justly, then it is fair. (một cách công bằng)
➔ We justly decided to give the prize to him.
14
leather[leðər]n.
Leather is a material made from animal skin that is used to make clothing. (da)
➔ He got a new leather jacket for his birthday.
15
ponder[pandər]v.
To ponder something is to think about it carefully. (suy nghĩ, cân nhắc)
➔ She sat in the park and pondered her problem.
16
reserve[rizərv]v.
To reserve something means to keep it for a certain person or time. (đặt trước, dành trước)
➔ He reserved a table at the busy restaurant.
17
script[skript]n.
A script is the words of a film or play. (kịch bản)
➔ He read the script of the play three times.
18
search[sərʧ]v.
To search for something or someone means to look for them carefully. (tìm kiếm)
➔ I searched the newspaper for a new job.
19
slam[slæm]v.
To slam is to close something hard. (đóng sầm)
➔ She slammed the book shut after she finished reading it.
20
staircase[steərkeis]n.
A staircase is a set of stairs found inside a building. (cầu thang)
➔ The staircase leads directly into the kitchen.

b. basement

d. errand

questions.content: 2. to think about something

b. reserve
c. ponder
d. slam

questions.content: 3. the written words of a play or film

b. blank
c. barber
d. gloves

questions.content: 4. a group that sings
options: a. hermits
b. leather
c. choir
d. staircases

questions.content: 5. in a fair way

b. decline
c. searching

d. to save

questions.content: 2. decline
options: a. to look for
b. to say no
c. to be right

questions.content: 3. hermit

questions.content: 4. leather

c. an underground room

sections.title: Exercise 2 Part A: Match the phrases to make complete sentences.

questions.content: 1. The writer's comic stories_____
options: a. always make me laugh
b. led up to the second floor
c. before buying a new car
d. made him hard to understand
questions.explanation: Nhà văn viết truyện hài nên luôn làm tôi cười (always make me laugh).

questions.content: 2. Donna usually ran errands_____
options: a. after hearing them sing in church
b. slept in small cave
c. just before I left the house
d. right before coming home from work
questions.explanation: Donna thường chạy việc vặt ngay trước khi đi làm về nhà (right before coming home from work).

questions.content: 3. I tried to reserve_____
options: a. some seats for this week's show
b. makes a great playroom
c. led up to the second floor
d. always make me laugh
questions.explanation: reserve some seats: đặt trước một vài chỗ ngồi.

questions.content: 4. She wanted to join the choir_____
options: a. after hearing them sing in church
b. made him hard to understand
c. just before I left the house
d. before buying a new car
questions.explanation: Tham gia dàn hợp xướng (choir) sau khi nghe họ hát ở nhà thờ.

questions.content: 5. A beautiful staircase_____
options: a. slept in small cave
b. led up to the second floor
c. right before coming home from work
d. some seats for this week's show
questions.explanation: Cầu thang đẹp đẽ dẫn lên tầng 2 (led up to the second floor).

questions.content: 6. The speaker's strong accent_____
options: a. made him hard to understand
b. always make me laugh
c. makes a great playroom
d. right before coming home from work
questions.explanation: Giọng địa phương quá nặng (strong accent) khiến anh ta khó bị hiểu.

questions.content: 7. Roger pondered a long time_____
options: a. led up to the second floor
b. before buying a new car
c. after hearing them sing in church
d. some seats for this week's show
questions.explanation: ponder: suy nghĩ cân nhắc trước khi mua ô tô mới.

questions.content: 8. The hermit_____
options: a. just before I left the house
b. makes a great playroom
c. slept in small cave
d. right before coming home from work
questions.explanation: hermit: người ẩn dật ngủ trong một hang nhỏ (slept in small cave).

questions.content: 9. I remembered to make sure I had my gloves_____
options: a. just before I left the house
b. led up to the second floor
c. always make me laugh
d. after hearing them sing in church
questions.explanation: Tôi nhớ mang găng tay trước khi rời khỏi nhà (just before I left the house).

questions.content: 10. The large basement_____
options: a. makes a great playroom
b. made him hard to understand
c. before buying a new car
d. some seats for this week's show
questions.explanation: Tầng hầm rộng lớn có thể tạo thành một phòng chơi tuyệt vời (makes a great playroom).

sections.title: Exercise 2 Part B: Match the clauses to make complete sentences.

questions.content: 1. I put some medicine in my eyes,_____
options: a. so I had to keep blinking them
b. so he cleaned the leather couch
c. but she declined
d. it was completely blank
questions.explanation: Tôi nhỏ thuốc vào mắt nên tôi phải liên tục chớp mắt (keep blinking them).

questions.content: 2. The boy's mom yelled at him for getting mud on the couch,_____
options: a. because Tony spent a lot of time on the script
b. so he cleaned the leather couch
c. so doing the homework was complicated
d. so he left the room and slammed the door
questions.explanation: Cậu bé làm bẩn ghế bằng bùn nên mẹ la, do đó cậu phải làm sạch chiếc ghế da (cleaned the leather couch).

questions.content: 3. He asked Sara to see the scary movie,_____
options: a. so I went to see the barber
b. so he had to search for them for an hour
c. but she declined
d. so they justly shared the prize
questions.explanation: Anh ta rủ Sara xem phim kinh dị, nhưng cô ấy từ chối (declined).

questions.content: 4. He spent the period daydreaming. So when he turned in his test,_____
options: a. it was completely blank
b. so I had to keep blinking them
c. so he cleaned the leather couch
d. because Tony spent a lot of time on the script
questions.explanation: Cậu ta mộng du cả tiết. Khi nộp bài kiểm tra thì nó hoàn toàn để trắng (completely blank).

questions.content: 5. The new play was great_____
options: a. because Tony spent a lot of time on the script
b. so doing the homework was complicated
c. so he left the room and slammed the door
d. so I went to see the barber
questions.explanation: Vở kịch rất tuyệt vì Tony đã dành nhiều thời gian cho kịch bản (on the script).

questions.content: 6. I didn't pay attention in class,_____
options: a. so doing the homework was complicated
b. so he had to search for them for an hour
c. so they justly shared the prize
d. but she declined
questions.explanation: Tôi không chú ý trong lớp nên làm bài tập về nhà trở nên phức tạp (was complicated).

questions.content: 7. My hair was a mess,_____
options: a. so I went to see the barber
b. it was completely blank
c. so I had to keep blinking them
d. so he cleaned the leather couch
questions.explanation: Tóc tôi rối bù nên tôi đến gặp thợ cắt tóc (went to see the barber).

questions.content: 8. He couldn't stand the sound of the music,_____
options: a. so he left the room and slammed the door
b. because Tony spent a lot of time on the script
c. so he had to search for them for an hour
d. so doing the homework was complicated
questions.explanation: Anh ta không chịu được tiếng nhạc nên rời phòng và đóng sầm cửa (slammed the door).

questions.content: 9. Dean and Anne finished the race at the same time,_____
options: a. so they justly shared the prize
b. so I went to see the barber
c. but she declined
d. it was completely blank
questions.explanation: Cả hai về đích cùng lúc nên họ được chia giải một cách công bằng (justly shared the prize).

questions.content: 10. He lost his glasses,_____
options: a. so he had to search for them for an hour
b. so he left the room and slammed the door
c. so I had to keep blinking them
d. because Tony spent a lot of time on the script
questions.explanation: Anh ta làm mất kính nên phải tìm kiếm (search for) chúng cả giờ.

parts.title: Comprehensive Reading
parts.content:
The School Play

Peter was excited. Next week he was going to audition for the school play. Everybody knew he was a great actor. He was sure he would get the lead role.

Later, his friend Robby asked him, "Have you seen the script for the play?"

"Yes. The title is The Lost Glove—it's a comic play," replied Peter.

Robby said, "I want to play the part of the hermit because the hermit gets to talk with an accent!"

"I want the lead role of the barber. I didn't know you liked acting. I thought you liked choir better," said Peter.

"Acting is also a hobby of mine. Do you want to practice with me? The basement at my house is quiet. It's perfect!" Robby replied.

"I don't like practicing with others. It complicates the process for me," said Peter.

Actually, Peter didn't want to practice at all. The teacher would surely reserve the lead part for him. A few days later, Robby came to his house.

Robby said, "Do you want to practice the scene on the staircase? It's the part where the migrant searches for a new job."

Peter declined the invitation. "I can't today. I need to do some errands." Then he slammed the door. It was just an excuse. Peter didn't want to help Robby.

On the day of auditions, Peter wore his lucky leather jacket. He always got the best part when he wore it. The teacher told him to begin, but his mind was blank. He couldn't remember the lines!

A week later, the teacher put a list of the parts on the wall. Peter read the list, looking for his name. He was shocked by what he saw. He blinked his eyes and looked again. He didn't get the lead part—Robby did! Peter pondered the situation and came to the idea that Robby justly received the part. He earned it by practicing. Next time, Peter would practice, too!

sections.title: Reading Comprehension Part A: Mark each statement T for true or F for false.

questions.content: 1. The title of the script was The Big Barber.
options: A. True
B. False
questions.explanation: Trong bài viết: "The title is The Lost Glove—it's a comic play," kịch bản có tên The Lost Glove, không phải The Big Barber.

questions.content: 2. Robby wanted the part of the hermit because he would get to talk with an accent.
options: A. True
B. False
questions.explanation: Robby nói: "I want to play the part of the hermit because the hermit gets to talk with an accent!"

questions.content: 3. Robby declined Peter's offer to practice together.
options: A. True
B. False
questions.explanation: Sự thật là Peter từ chối lời mời của Robby, chứ không phải Robby từ chối Peter.

questions.content: 4. The scene on the staircase was about the migrant searching for a new job.
options: A. True
B. False
questions.explanation: Robby nói: "Do you want to practice the scene on the staircase? It's the part where the migrant searches for a new job."

questions.content: 5. Peter's mind was blank during the audition.
options: A. True
B. False
questions.explanation: Bài đọc viết: "The teacher told him to begin, but his mind was blank."

questions.content: 6. Peter felt that Robby justly received the lead role.
options: A. True
B. False
questions.explanation: Bài đọc viết: "Peter pondered the situation and came to the idea that Robby justly received the part."

sections.title: Reading Comprehension Part B: Answer the questions.

questions.content: 1. Why did Peter decide not to practice?
options: a. He didn't want the part.
b. He thought the teacher would give him the role.
c. He disliked Robby.
d. He wanted to be in the choir instead.
questions.explanation: Peter nghĩ giáo viên chắc chắn sẽ giữ vai chính cho mình (The teacher would surely reserve the lead part for him).

questions.content: 2. Where did Robby suggest they practice together?
options: a. At the school
b. In his basement
c. At the theater
d. In the park
questions.explanation: Robby đề nghị: "The basement at my house is quiet. It's perfect!"

questions.content: 3. What was Peter's first excuse for not practicing with Robby?
options: a. He had to run errands.
b. He had to study for a test.
c. He said it complicated the process.
d. Robby lived too far away.
questions.explanation: Lý do đầu tiên Peter đưa ra là: "I don't like practicing with others. It complicates the process for me"

questions.content: 4. What kind of play were the boys auditioning for?
options: a. Romance
b. Comic
c. Drama
d. Action
questions.explanation: Peter mô tả kịch bản: "The title is The Lost Glove—it's a comic play"
